# LED PWM connector (RJ11 -> Grove) 3D-printed case

Two-part case for the 50 x 28 mm PoESP_ConnectorBoard. External size
**58 x 47 x 25 mm** plus wall-mount ears. Generated by `led_pwm_case.py` from
data parsed directly out of the Altium `PoESP_ConnectorBoard.PcbDoc` (the
project has no gerber outputs).

## Files

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `LEDPWM-Case-Base.stl` | Tray: M3 bosses, corner posts, RJ11 + Grove ports, ears |
| `LEDPWM-Case-Lid.stl`  | Lid with Chill Division logo deboss (already flipped for printing) |
| `led_pwm_case.py`      | Parametric generator (`pip install manifold3d numpy matplotlib contourpy`) |
| `render_preview.py`    | Regenerates the preview PNGs |
| `chill_logo.png`       | Logo source bitmap for the deboss |

## Design notes

- **The board has four M3 mounting holes** (3.0 mm PTH with 4.5 mm pads) at
  (4,4) (46,4) (46,24) (4,24) — despite appearances, so the PCB screws to
  Ø8 bosses, 4.5 mm tall (the RJ11 pins and snap posts reach ~3.2 mm below
  the board).
- Grove port (13 x 9 mm) in the left wall, RJ11 port (14 x 12.4 mm) in the
  right wall; both walls hug the board at 1.5 mm so the plugs latch home.
- Lid registers with an inner lip (cut away over the RJ11, which stands
  ~11.5 mm tall) and screws into quarter-round corner posts.
- The Chill Division logo is debossed 0.4 mm into the lid top (30 mm wide,
  `LOGO_W` / `LOGO_DEPTH` to taste). The lid prints face-down so the logo
  comes out crisp against the build plate.
- LED1/R2 are not populated on this board (deliberately — no glowing in the
  grow room) and nothing in the case depends on them.

## Hardware

- 8x M3 knurled brass heat-set inserts (4 mm, 4.5 mm OD) — 4 bosses + 4 posts
- 4x M3 machine screws (M3 x 6–8) — PCB to bosses
- 4x M3 machine screws (M3 x 10–12) — lid to corner posts
- 2x M4 (or #8) screws + anchors, through the mounting ears

## Printing

- **Base**: prints as oriented, no supports.
- **Lid**: STL is already flipped — outer (logo) face on the bed.
- PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters, ~20 % infill.

## Assembly

1. Drop the board onto the bosses (Grove socket to the ported left wall) and
   fix with the four M3 x 8 screws.
2. Fit the lid (lip cut-out over the RJ11) and drive the four M3 x 12 screws.
